title: [SMM Analysis] Steel billet peaks, Türkiye's historic volume turns positive, India leads the gains in growth
dek: Shanghai Metals Market analysis says steel billet has peaked, with Türkiye's historic volume turning positive and India leading growth gains.
summary: According to a Shanghai Metals Market analysis headline, steel billet has peaked, Türkiye's historic volume has turned positive and India leads the gains in growth. No excerpt was provided, so the price levels, volumes and time periods behind these statements are not given.
keyFacts: SMM says steel billet has peaked
Türkiye's historic volume has turned positive
India leads the gains in growth
whyItMatters: Billet is a key semi-finished traded product, and a view that prices have peaked could signal a turn in sentiment for semis markets in which India and Türkiye are active.
implications: Billet traders and re-rollers may treat the analysis as a cue to watch for softer offers, though the excerpt gives no supporting figures.
